pages.title: Metallic Hydrogen Ingot
pages.text: Hydrogen compressed until its electrons are shared freely, like a metal. In the cores of Jupiter and Saturn it is the dominant form. It is probably metastable at ordinary pressure, and conducts electricity and heat beautifully. The ingot is mirror-bright and surprisingly light.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Bose-Einstein Condenser, I pressed Liquid Metallic Hydrogen between Casimir Plates and cooled it. When the pressure was released, it held its metallic state. Probably. I have kept an eye on it.
